description: The owner's FlexiHAL router as a machine, and a setup on it. The values are estimates, not yet measured on the machine. Homing puts machine zero in the front right corner with Z up: X travels 650 mm to the left (negative), Y 1000 mm back, Z 130 mm down. A turns about X on the table, continuously, its centre at Y 300 and 40 mm above the table, which is at Z -20; positive A is clockwise seen from X+, so it turns about -X. The post is grblHAL.
